listing.name: Solana MCP by Vybe
listing.tagline: Live Solana wallet, token, and market data
listing.description:
Solana MCP by Vybe is a developer toolkit for live Solana data: wallets, trades, markets, PnL, transfers, on-chain activity, and signable swaps. Ask for a wallet's balances, realized and unrealized PnL, counterparties, or token holdings. Look up token prices, holders, liquidity, and candles. Scan markets, DEX activity, trade history, and transfers. Pull top traders and labeled accounts without leaving Claude.

Each tool calls one Vybe API endpoint. When you need a swap, close token accounts, or withdraw MEV, build-swap, build-close-token-accounts, or build-withdraw-mev returns a base64 unsigned payload for the user to review and sign in their own wallet. The connector never collects private keys and never broadcasts transactions.

Connect with OAuth on mcp.vybenetwork.xyz.

primary: Wallet analytics: balances, holdings, realized and unrealized PnL, transfers, counterparties
Token and market intelligence: prices, holders, liquidity, candles, DEX trades, top traders
One tool per Vybe endpoint, including unsigned swap, close-account, and withdraw-MEV payloads
use_cases.prerequisites: A Vybe account. OAuth on mcp.vybenetwork.xyz issues the API session. No private keys.
use_cases.write_explanation: build-swap, build-close-token-accounts, and build-withdraw-mev construct unsigned payloads. The user signs in their own wallet. The connector does not transfer assets, sign, or broadcast.
